caption: The drawing depicts a single bird, specifically a bird of prey such as a hawk or an eagle, positioned facing away from the viewer with its head turned to the right in profile. The bird is rendered in fine detail using shades of gray, emphasizing the texture and layering of its feathers across the wings, back, and tail. The bird perches on a horizontal, slightly curved branch that appears roughly sketched. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of a light beige color with minor variations and faint evidence of aging or discoloration near the edges. There is a small, simple handwritten signature "Helen Hobart" in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Pin Tray
